title: PUT /books/{id} is a full replace, not a partial update
evidence: lib.rs:217-225 update() sets all four columns; omitted optional year/isbn become null (README documents this).
suggestion: Acceptable per spec ("Update a book"). If partial-update (PATCH) semantics are ever wanted, keep existing values for omitted fields.

title: Single shared SQLite connection serialized by a Mutex
evidence: lib.rs:16 Database(Arc<Mutex<Connection>>); lib.rs:40-43 db.run() locks the one connection on spawn_blocking.
suggestion: Fine for this task's scale. A connection pool (e.g. r2d2/deadpool) would allow concurrent reads if throughput ever matters.
